## :mega: 获取其他软件包 / How to Get Other Packages

### 方式 1：添加软件源 / Method 1: Add Software Source
 * 请按照 [openwrt-passwall-build](https://github.com/moetayuko/openwrt-passwall-build) 仓库的说明，将其提供的软件源添加到设备中，然后直接使用包管理器安装。
  Follow the instructions in the [openwrt-passwall-build](https://github.com/moetayuko/openwrt-passwall-build) repository to add the provided software source to your device, then install directly using the package manager.

### 方式 2：手动下载并安装 / Method 2: Manual Download and Install

* 从 [SourceForge](https://sourceforge.net/projects/openwrt-passwall-build/files/) 下载预构建的软件包。
  Download prebuilt packages from [SourceForge](https://sourceforge.net/projects/openwrt-passwall-build/files/).

* 将文件上传到您的设备，使用 Shell 命令进行安装。
  Upload files to your device, install it with shell command.

ipk
```
opkg install /path/to/package.ipk
```
apk
```
apk add --allow-untrusted /path/to/package.apk
```

:warning: 请将 /path/to/package 替换为实际下载的软件包路径。
- Replace /path/to/package with the actual path of the downloaded packages.

---
## :rocket: 配套固件与工具 / Firmwares & Tools

### :fire: [OpenWrtAction](https://github.com/smallprogram/OpenWrtAction) —— 集成 Passwall 的 CI 固件 / Ready-to-use firmware with Passwall
* 集成官方 OpenWrt 25.12、ImmortalWrt 25.12、Lean (Snapshot) 固件，支持 x86、R2S、R2C、R4S、R5S、R5C、H66K、H68K、H69K、R66S、R68S 等设备，刷入即用。
  Firmware built on official OpenWrt 25.12, ImmortalWrt 25.12 and Lean (Snapshot), supporting x86, R2S, R2C, R4S, R5S, R5C, H66K, H68K, H69K, R66S, R68S and more.
* 支持 GitHub 一键更新：直接从 GitHub Releases 在线升级固件，无需手动下载和刷写。
  Supports one-click GitHub update: upgrade the firmware online straight from GitHub Releases, no manual download or flashing needed.

### :package: [Are-u-ok](https://github.com/bcseputetto/Are-u-ok) —— iStoreOS .run 更新包 / iStoreOS .run update packages
* 为 iStoreOS 提供 .run 格式更新包，无需重刷固件，上传执行即可安装/升级。
  Provides .run update packages for iStoreOS — no reflashing needed, just upload and run.

## 📌如何能编译到最新代码？

### 方法1：

执行 `./scripts/feeds update -a` 操作前，在 `feeds.conf.default` **顶部**插入如下代码：

```
src-git passwall_packages https://github.com/Openwrt-Passwall/openwrt-passwall-packages.git;main
src-git passwall_luci https://github.com/Openwrt-Passwall/openwrt-passwall.git;main
```

### 方法2：

在 `./scripts/feeds install -a` 操作完成后，执行以下命令：

```shell
# 移除 openwrt feeds 自带的核心库
rm -rf feeds/packages/net/{xray-core,v2ray-geodata,sing-box,chinadns-ng,dns2socks,hysteria,ipt2socks,microsocks,naiveproxy,shadowsocks-rust,shadowsocksr-libev,simple-obfs,tcping,v2ray-plugin,xray-plugin,geoview,shadow-tls,smartdns}
git clone https://github.com/Openwrt-Passwall/openwrt-passwall-packages package/passwall-packages

# 移除 openwrt feeds 过时的luci版本
rm -rf feeds/luci/applications/luci-app-passwall
git clone https://github.com/Openwrt-Passwall/openwrt-passwall package/passwall-luci
```

## 🚀 配套固件与工具

### 🔥 [OpenWrtAction](https://github.com/smallprogram/OpenWrtAction) —— 开箱即用的 Passwall 固件

[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/smallprogram/OpenWrtAction?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/smallprogram/OpenWrtAction)

基于 GitHub Actions 全自动云编译的固件仓库，集成最新 Passwall，刷入即用，无需自行折腾编译环境。

- 📦 **多源码分支**：官方 OpenWrt 25.12、ImmortalWrt 25.12、Lean (Snapshot)
- 🖥️ **多设备覆盖**：x86、R2S、R2C、R4S、R5S、R5C、H66K、H68K、H69K、R66S、R68S 等
- 🔄 **持续更新**：CI 自动构建，紧跟上游与 Passwall 最新版本
- ⚡ **GitHub 一键更新**：支持直接从 GitHub Releases 一键在线升级固件，告别手动下载、上传、刷写

👉 前往下载：[OpenWrtAction Releases](https://github.com/smallprogram/OpenWrtAction/releases)
